title: SCDN 原生 TCP / UDP 实时观测

panels.title: Nginx TCP 套接字
panels.description: 连接按 Nginx PID 树归属；报文按指定网卡/监听端口归属。UDP 套接字不等同 QUIC 会话；采集缺失或初次速率显示无数据。

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, node AS metric, JSONExtract(connections, 'nginx_tcp_sockets', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS value FROM scdn.network_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) ORDER BY time
